market.question: Will the highest temperature in London be 17°C on May 4?

assessment.reasoning: Met Office/BBC forecasts cited highest temperature in London on May 4 at 17-18°C with overcast/showers. The market resolves on hitting exactly 17°C as the daytime high. With forecast point estimate spanning 17-18°C, probability of the high landing exactly at 17 is moderate; most-likely outcomes are 17 or 18.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the daytime high lands at 17 vs 18 vs 16°C — within forecast uncertainty band.
